Primary sources (same as curated calendar file):

1. NSE Circular **NSE/CMTR/54757** (08 Dec 2022) — 2023 CM trading holidays  
2. NSE Circular **NSE/CMTR/59124** (27 Oct 2023) — Muhurat Trading 2023-11-12  
3. NSE Circular **NSE/CMTR/59722** (12 Dec 2023) — 2024 CM trading holidays
